summary: Each edition was independently checked against all six paragraphs of the supplied working Greek. Both preserve the sorrow/Spirit/saving tension, the causal explanations, contextual repentance, the qualified salvation assertion, the warning about petition and departure, and the final negation covering both sorrow and anguish. The notes disclose the bracketed editorial status of “against you” and the stated alternative readings without replacing or harmonizing the working text. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Acceptance concerns fidelity to the supplied source and disclosure of the stated alternatives; it does not verify the cited editions, manuscript readings, handwriting, restoration history, or exhaustive collation.
